Sprinter, limo and party bus service in Scottsdale

Scottsdale is our home city and the bulk of our nightly work. We run Old Town bar and restaurant crawls, resort and golf transfers around Troon and DC Ranch, Kierland shopping and dinner runs, and airport transfers from every corner of the city — from South Scottsdale up through Pinnacle Peak.

How we work in Scottsdale

Scottsdale Sprinters is based here, and Sprinters lead the lineup, with party buses, mini coaches and a motorcoach behind them. Typical trips: airport runs, Old Town nights, Scottsdale Stadium event days and Sedona day tours. Old Town punishes anyone who tries to park on a Friday night. A chauffeur drops your group at the door of the Entertainment District, waits out of the way, and collects you at the same spot when you are done. Groups moving between the Waterfront, Fifth Avenue and Scottsdale Stadium keep one vehicle for the whole night rather than juggling rideshares.

Where we pick up in Scottsdale

We pick up at private residences, the airpark business district, Scottsdale Fashion Square, and resort porte-cocheres across Gainey Ranch, McCormick Ranch and the north Scottsdale communities. Old Town pickups are set at a named cross street rather than a crowded kerb, so the group and the chauffeur are never hunting for each other.

What a booking costs in Scottsdale

The fleet seats 6 to 56. Below are the Sprinters first, then the group end, each with the rate, the minimum, what that minimum comes to and the per-person figure the pricing page publishes for the same vehicle, on the same basis. The full grid is on the pricing page, and it is the same grid in Scottsdale as everywhere else we serve.

An hourly charter carries a 4-hour minimum on every listed vehicle, and a 5-hour minimum on the 56-Passenger Motorcoach. A point-to-point transfer has no hourly minimum at all: it is flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off, and a longer transfer is priced from the drive with the empty return included, with the basis shown on the quote.

What you pay at checkout depends on the method you choose. Some methods take a 50% deposit and charge the balance to that same method no earlier than 48 hours before pickup; others settle in full at checkout and leave nothing due before the ride. Checkout says which applies to yours before you confirm.

Cancellation is decided by the date first. An ordinary date refunds in full 14 or more days ahead; a reservation of 20 or more passengers or 2 or more vehicles refunds in full 30 or more days ahead, with the deposit kept from there in to 14 days; and a major-event date overrides both — its deposit is not refundable and the balance returns only 60 or more days ahead.

Added at the end: 8% Arizona tax, and nothing else — no booking fee and no fuel fee. A promotion code is capped at 10%. Gratuity is optional and is never added for you. Taking the return leg together with the outbound takes 20% off the return leg. An added stop is $50 on a transfer or a round trip and is complimentary on an hourly charter.

Frequently asked questions

Where do you pick up in Old Town Scottsdale on a busy night?

At a named cross street in the Entertainment District rather than a crowded kerb. Your chauffeur texts on arrival, waits off the main strip, and returns to the same spot each time your group moves between venues, so nobody is looking for a vehicle at midnight.

Can one vehicle cover a whole Scottsdale evening?

Yes, and it is the cheaper way to do it. Vehicles are booked by the hour with a published minimum, so a group can hold the same Sprinter for dinner in Old Town, a stop at the Waterfront and the ride home instead of paying for three separate trips.

Do you serve North Scottsdale resorts and golf courses?

Yes. We run transfers across the whole north of the city — the Kierland shopping district, the Troon and Pinnacle Peak corridor, DC Ranch and the communities around them — plus the airpark for private aviation arrivals.

How far ahead should a Scottsdale group book?

Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Request a current quote for your date and we confirm in writing what is open. Weeknight groups and short-notice requests are still worth asking about; the reservations team answers the same way, in writing, before anything is paid.

Who offers chauffeured Sprinter service in Scottsdale?

Scottsdale Sprinters, based here. The rate table on this page prints every Sprinter with its seats, hourly rate and minimum.

Which Sprinter should a Scottsdale group book?

The Executive Black Sprinter (14 seats) for airport transfers, corporate travel and weddings; the Maybach Jet Sprinter (9 seats) for a proposal; a limo or party Sprinter for bachelorettes and birthdays.

Where are Scottsdale Sprinter prices published?

Here, in the rate table on this page, and on the pricing page: hourly rate, minimum and a per-person figure for each.

Can a Sprinter take us to Sedona for the day?

Yes, as a full-day hourly charter with one chauffeur throughout. The tours page lists the day trips.
